cases.reviewerAnswer: las flores blancas; las blancas flores is also possible with an explanatory or expressive reading.
cases.element: task.prompt[0].text: "«білі квіти» (ті, про які вже йшлося)"; task.errors[1].text: "las blancas flores." with an "unresolved" position outcome.
cases.defect: The prompt fixes definiteness but does not distinguish a restrictive description from an explanatory description of already identified flowers. Adjective placement can differ between these readings, and the reviewed prenominal alternative remains unresolved.
cases.correction: Specify that postnominal placement is required, or clarify the intended reading and settle acceptance of the reviewed alternative.
sources: Course contract rule 3 and the supplied definition of "uncertain".
RAE/ASALE, Nueva gramática de la lengua española, chapter 13, discussion of qualifying-adjective position and restrictive versus explanatory readings (from memory).
cases.notes: No closed flag is supplied; this finding concerns the explicitly reviewed alternative, not automatic rejection of unlisted answers.

cases.element: task.prompt[0].text: "Ти пишеш оголошення про продаж."; task.errors[1].text: "una roja moto." with an "unresolved" position outcome.
cases.defect: The reference answer suits ordinary sales prose. The reviewed alternative's acceptability depends on whether expressive advertising language is permitted; the prompt does not expressly settle that register or require postnominal placement.
cases.correction: Require ordinary neutral wording with the adjective after the noun, or specify whether expressive prenominal wording is admissible and classify it accordingly.
sources: Course contract rule 3 and the supplied definition of "uncertain".
RAE/ASALE, Nueva gramática de la lengua española, chapter 13, discussion of qualifying-adjective position and expressive prenominal uses (from memory).
cases.notes: The prenominal alternative is marked, rather than an equally neutral replacement. Its outcome is unresolved, not explicitly incorrect.

cases.element: task.prompt[0].text: "«цікаві книжки»"; task.errors[1].text: "unos interesantes libros." with an "unresolved" position outcome.
cases.defect: The translation does not distinguish restrictive postnominal description from prenominal evaluation. Both orders can be grammatical, but the key leaves the reviewed evaluative alternative unresolved.

cases.element: task.errors[1].text: "unas chicas jovenes."; its "adj.agreement.invariable-gender/written-form" outcome is "unresolved".
cases.defect: This is a reviewed, demonstrably incorrect written form. Jóvenes requires the written accent, and that spelling is explicitly taught in context.taughtBefore. Its written-form error is therefore settled rather than unresolved.
cases.correction: Set the written-form outcome to incorrect. Feedback may acknowledge correct gender and number agreement while identifying the missing written accent.
sources: Course contract rules 3 and 5.
Packet: context.taughtBefore explicitly includes "joven, jóvenes".
RAE/ASALE, Ortografía de la lengua española (2010), chapter II, accentuation of esdrújulas (from memory).

cases.reviewerAnswer: un hotel grande; un gran hotel can also fit, depending on the intended descriptive or evaluative reading.
cases.element: task.prompt[0].text: "«великий готель»"; task.errors[1].text: "un gran hotel." with both outcomes "unresolved".
cases.defect: The prompt does not establish the intended interpretation of "великий" sufficiently to settle the reviewed alternative. Gran can express evaluation and can also occur with a size interpretation, as the packet's feedback acknowledges.
cases.correction: Specify the intended meaning and, if postnominal placement is the assessment requirement, state that requirement explicitly before classifying the alternative.
sources: Course contract rule 3 and the supplied definition of "uncertain".
RAE/ASALE, Diccionario panhispánico de dudas, entry "grande", discussion of apocope and prenominal use (from memory).
cases.notes: For greater precision, the apocope explanation could explicitly refer to singular nouns; the example itself is singular.
